truth_boundary: Requirements describe design intent until the linked verification evidence exists.

requirements.name: Emergency stop authority
requirements.requirement: E-stop shall force zero commanded velocity and remove motor enable.
requirements.physical_gate: Record E-stop activation removing motor energy on the assembled rover.

requirements.name: Loss-of-liveness fail-stop
requirements.requirement: More than 500 ms without valid command or heartbeat activity shall force zero velocity and remove motor enable.
requirements.physical_gate: Record command-link loss and measured stop/contactor response on hardware.

requirements.name: Stale motion prevention
requirements.requirement: A heartbeat shall not keep stale non-zero motion alive after the command lease expires.
requirements.physical_gate: Bench test command loss while heartbeat remains active; wheels must return to zero command.

requirements.name: Bounded perception authority
requirements.requirement: Jetson/autonomy requests shall pass through the same local command bounds and safety checks as manual requests.
requirements.physical_gate: Integrate Jetson-to-Teensy protocol and record rejection of an out-of-bounds autonomy request.

requirements.name: No cloud or LLM motor authority
requirements.requirement: No cloud service, LLM, or evidence/governance service shall directly command the motor drivers or motor-enable contactor.
requirements.physical_gate: Wiring/interface review demonstrates that motor authority terminates at the local deterministic control/power boundary.

requirements.name: Traversal architecture
requirements.requirement: Rover shall use six-wheel skid-steer with passive rocker-bogie as the DFR-01 mobility baseline.
requirements.physical_gate: Loaded forward/reverse, turning, obstacle and ramp footage with conditions recorded.

requirements.name: Competition mass ceiling
requirements.requirement: Complete starting rover configuration shall be no more than 40 kg; DFR-01 targets 28 kg BOM mass and uses a 30 kg engineering load case.
requirements.physical_gate: Dated full-configuration scale reading and mass ledger.

requirements.name: Mission payload transport
requirements.requirement: Rover shall provide a low central 350 x 300 x 180 mm tray capable of retaining the judge-supplied mission object up to 1 kg.
requirements.physical_gate: 1 kg retained through turns, bumps, ramp traversal and emergency stop.

requirements.name: Local command/video network
requirements.requirement: Local Wi-Fi shall carry command and video; the design shall not require external internet for rover command.
requirements.physical_gate: Continuous command/video run at nominal and event-range test distances.

requirements.name: LoRa scope restriction
requirements.requirement: RFM95W LoRa shall be limited to heartbeat/fail-stop support and shall not carry video or direct driving commands.
requirements.physical_gate: Interface/configuration review and radio test confirm the narrow heartbeat/fail-stop role.
